chunks: My father, may Allah have mercy on him, narrated to us, saying: Ali ibn Ibrahim narrated to us, from his father, from Muhammad ibn Khalid al-Barqi, from Abu Qatadah al-Qummi, who ascribed it to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), that he said:

What is manliness (al-muru'ah)? We said: We do not know. He said: Manliness is that a man places his dining table in the unroofed space of his home. Manliness consists of two types of manliness - then he mentioned the like of the narration that preceded.

key_terms.الْمُرُوءَةُ: Manliness, moral excellence, or virtue, often associated with generosity and hospitality.
key_terms.بِفَنَاءِ دَارِهِ: In the unroofed courtyard or open space of his house, indicating accessibility and openness.
key_terms.خَوَانَهِ: His dining table or spread, referring to the place where food is laid out.

ai.seo_question: What is the definition of Muru'ah (manliness/moral excellence) in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Mani al-Akhbar*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) redefines *al-muru'ah* (moral excellence) by shifting the focus from martial bravery to social generosity, specifically illustrating it through the act of placing one's dining table in the courtyard for communal sharing. This definition highlights the Shia emphasis on *karam* (generosity) and *israr* (openness) as core components of character, suggesting that true manliness is measured by one's willingness to share resources openly with the community rather than hoarding them.

en.basel-kadem: 9.	We were told by my father, may Allah grant him mercy, that he said: We were told by Ali bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Muhammed bin Khalid al-Barqi, from Abu Qutada al-Qommi, that he ascribed it to Abu Abdillah, peace be upon him, that he said:

What is manliness? We said: We do not know. He said: Manliness is that a man places his dining table in the unroofed space of his home. Manliness is (consisting of) two (dimensions of) manlinesses. Then he mentioned the like of the narration that preceded.
